# case03_PlaneWave_Pitch4：纯相干平面波、4×4 Pitch、无独立人眼入瞳的远场对照
# 图样对齐阶段：仅Anode/BM；Anode统一反射，BM理想不透明黑区；不含CF/IJP
stack.layerNames = ["Anode", "BM"]
stack.layerLevels = [1, 2]
stack.backgroundMode = "absorber"
stack.incidentN = 1
stack.exitN = 1

stack.layers.Anode.method = "reflectance"
stack.layers.Anode.reflectance = 1
stack.layers.Anode.phaseDeg = 180
stack.layers.Anode.thickness = 0
stack.layers.BM.file = "BM"
stack.layers.BM.invert = true
stack.layers.BM.method = "reflectance"
stack.layers.BM.reflectance = 0
stack.layers.BM.thickness = 0
stack.geometry.source = "images"
stack.geometry.threshold = 0.5
stack.geometry.repeatToFit = true
stack.geometry.inputSamplesPerPeriod = 250
cfg.pitch = 59.06e-6
cfg.periods = [4, 4]
cfg.samplesPerPeriod = 64
cfg.heightMap = 0
cfg.propagationDistance = 100
cfg.outputSize = 1801
cfg.angleHalfRangeDeg = 10
cfg.metricAngleDeg = 2.5
cfg.receiverBinSamples = 3
# z为光栅到接收面的距离；复用同一远场角图，以毫米显示尺寸变化。
cfg.receiverView.enabled = true
cfg.receiverView.distances = [0.25, 0.5, 1]
# 三波长相对权重采样自D65；这是RGB图样代理，不是完整D65色度积分
spectrumMode = "RGB"
cfg.wavelengths = [6.2e-7, 5.5e-7, 4.5e-7]

spotOptions.wavelengthNm = [620, 550, 450]
# 平面波基线：不进行面源卷积；distance对plane不生效
cfg.source.type = "plane"
cfg.source.distance = 0.05
cfg.source.diameter = 0
cfg.source.integrationMethod = "direct"
cfg.source.wavefront = "plane"
observation.centerDeg = [0, 0]
observation.halfAngleDeg = 2.5
observation.innerHalfAngleDeg = 0
observation.curveSamples = 301
displayStyle.showAnnotations = false
saveResults = true
showProgress = true
caseName = "coe_reflection"

# 物面照明范围：rectangle/circle/none；长度单位m，仅对plane照明生效
cfg.source.apertureShape = "none"
cfg.source.rectangleSize = [0.001, 0.001]
cfg.source.circleDiameter = 0.001

# 仅有限反射面参与远场；取消人眼入瞳和观察距离缩放。
# cfg.pupilRadius沿用main默认Inf，仅由4×4有限计算面限定反射范围。
cfg.observer.enabled = false
cfg.observer.pupilDiameter = 0
rgbOptions.mode = "legacy"
rgbOptions.clipQuantile = 0.9985
